claims.text: Cloudflare/clef (Apache-2.0, 27.36B bf16, Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B, 48 GDN + 16 full-attn layers, ViT present, mtp_num_hidden_layers=0) is a DECISION model, not a chat model: a joint schema head over the backbone's final hidden states emits one logit per allowed option per question in one forward pass — no free-form generation (huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef card + config.json).

claims.text: Clef's 4-bit checkpoint on the Orin (Ampere sm_87) must be WEIGHT-ONLY W4A16 through Marlin: W4A4 NVFP4 needs Blackwell FP4 tensor cores and is ruled out (lobes/machines/orin.py:10-30) and FP8 W8A8 is unsupported on Ampere. Lead candidate JRamirez-UAB/clef-GPTQ-W4A16-g64-embed-int8 (compressed-tensors, ~18 GB, head/ViT/lm_head bf16, vLLM 0.31.0 + a 4-line qwen3_5 embed-quant patch + clef_vllm.py pooling wrapper, 65/68 match vs bf16); second AutomatosX/AX-Clef-27B-CUDA-AXQ-NVFP4-W4A16; avoid kurcontko/simonlehmann clef-NVFP4 (W4A4) and prithivMLmods/clef-FP8.

claims.text: Strands Decider 2B (StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610, Apache-2.0, AWS Strands Labs) is a rank-16 LoRA plus a ~1M-param fp32 pointer head on Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base with the LM head discarded; no merged weights ship; served by the strands-decider package ('strands-decider serve', POST /v1/systemone) — the same wire Clef speaks; trained/evaluated at a 4096-token window (strands-labs/strands-decider README, HF card).

Strands Decider 2B is served UNQUANTIZED (bf16 torso ~4.5 GiB + fp32 head): no official AWQ/GPTQ/W4A16/FP8 exists, LoRA over a 4-bit base is unvalidated on a GDN hybrid on sm_87 (vllm#29424 tested MoE only), the training recipe and adapters are bf16, and 4.5 GiB is small beside the Orin's ~43 GiB headroom. W4A16 (compressed-tensors/GPTQ) is the fallback only if memory forces it, measured first.

obligations.behavior: decider's responsibilities include final_decision and its forbidden list is exactly repo_action, security_decision; hand's contract still forbids final_decision
obligations.source_text: decider role contract: responsibilities typed_decision, classification, routing_choice, triage, guardrail_check, final_decision; forbidden repo_action, security_decision — it decides over a closed option set and returns the best answer + all probabilities, but never acts on the repo or rules on security.

obligations.behavior: a decider lane is ready:true when its GET /health answers 200, even though it serves no /v1/models
obligations.source_text: The decider lane's readiness probe uses a per-lane health path: strands-decider documents only POST /v1/systemone (no /health, no /v1/models), and lobes/gateway/_readiness.py probes /health then /v1/models — so a decider lane needs the probe_backend_ready health_path override the innereye lane already uses (_readiness.py:153-158), or it is advertised ready:false forever.

obligations.behavior: no decider-<domain> service has a ports: mapping; from another host the decider container port is refused while the gateway route answers
obligations.source_text: Decider containers publish NO host port and listen only on the compose network: the strands-decider server documents no auth, while the gateway's bearer gate covers every /v1/* path (lobes/gateway/server.py:5199) — the gateway is the only way in.

obligations.behavior: orin-decider is refused alongside orin-cortex / orin-lobe / orin-associate (one heavy lobe)
obligations.source_text: Clef takes the Orin's single heavy-lobe slot: orin.toml [[exclusive_roles]] (~:117-119) allows one of cortex/senses/associate (orin-cortex/orin-lobe/orin-associate) on 61.3 GiB unified with zero swap, so a Clef-hosting shape joins that exclusive group (and tests/test_init_coresidency.py) and cannot co-reside with the GGUF cortex (~33 GiB) or associate (util 0.70).

obligations.behavior: renders no decider service and DECIDER_FEASIBLE=false; model selection via X-Lobes-Model 404s role_infeasible
obligations.source_text: 'decider' is an OPT-IN core role (joins OPT_IN_CORE_ROLES like muse/worker/associate): machine-as-brain never hosts a 27B decision model beside cortex+senses, an unwired decider 404s role_infeasible, and only an explicit Orin shape hosts it.

obligations.behavior: Clef answers a choice question with per-question probabilities summing to 1 (±0.01) while embedder, reranker and gemma2-embed keep answering, and min available host memory stays >= 2 GiB
obligations.source_text: On the Orin, with orin-embed still serving: Clef (4-bit) answers a /v1/systemone choice question through the gateway with probabilities summing to 1 (±0.01) per question, top-1 accuracy on a fixed LABELED probe set (ground-truth answers, no bf16 reference run) is recorded beside the quant card's published bf16 agreement (65/68), and the minimum available host memory stays >= 2 GiB (orin-embed decision c25 floor); median decision latency for a <= 4096-token state is recorded (sidecar baseline, then the faster path).

obligations.behavior: a ~/.lobes backup exists before 'lobes init --shape orin-decider --apply' runs; rollback is restoring it
obligations.source_text: Moving the Orin from orin-embed to a Clef-hosting shape keeps orin-embed as the rollback: back up ~/.lobes before the render and restore the backup to roll back — a re-render alone is NOT a rollback (docs/orin-embed-deployment.md:136-147, ...-rollback-orin-embed-to-orin-associate.txt).

obligations.behavior: a 2B domain hosted on spark2 answers from the Orin, Spark and Thor gateways, each reply carrying X-Lobes-Mesh-Member: spark2
obligations.source_text: A Strands Decider 2B served bf16 on a second box (e.g. spark2) answers model=decider:<domain> from every other mesh member, with X-Lobes-Mesh-Member on the reply.
